PRESIDENT'S ORDER 26 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
26 OF 1985
HIGH COURT JUDGES
(LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th May, 1985]
No. F. 17 (3)/85-Pub.-The following Order made by the
President is hereby published for general information:-
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1970 (P.
O. No. 9 of 1970), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by paragraph 2 of the second part of the Fifth Schedule to
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased
to make the following Order, namely:--
l. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken
effect on the first day of March, 1985.
2. Amendment of paragraph 13, P. O. No. 9 of 1970.-In the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension and
Privileges) Order, 1970, (P. O. No. 9 of 1970), in paragraph 13,-
(a) in clause (b),-
(i) for the word "ten" the word
"five" shall be substituted; and
(ii) after the word "resigned",
the words "or sought retirement" shall be inserted; and
(b) in clause (c), after the word "incapacity", at the end,
the words "or been allowed by the President for sufficient cause to
retire" shall be added.
